target.title: fix(google): Veo video generation fails with google-prefixed model ids
target.body:
Closes #103291

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where calling `video_generate` with a Google Veo model prefixed as `google/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` (and similar `google/models/` or `models/` forms) would fail with an API key / model path error and never reach the `predictLongRunning` endpoint.

## Why This Change Was Made

The GenAI SDK treats any model id that does not start with `models/` or `tunedModels/` as `models/<input>`, so `google/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` becomes the invalid path `models/google/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview`. The provider now normalizes Veo video model ids to the bare form before both the SDK call and the REST fallback, ensuring the REST `predictLongRunning` path uses `models/veo-...`.

## User Impact

Users can now use `google/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview`, `google/models/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview`, or `veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` interchangeably for Google video generation.

## Evidence

- Added regression tests in `extensions/google/video-generation-provider.test.ts`:
  - SDK path normalizes `google/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` to `veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview`.
  - REST fallback hits `models/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview:predictLongRunning` when the SDK returns 404.
- Local focused test run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/video-generation-provider.test.ts` — 18 tests passed.
- Format/lint: `oxfmt` and `oxlint` clean on changed files.
